reason: No patched release exists (1.4.0 is the latest). Only reached via @expo/code-signing-certificates (expo-updates and @expo/cli), which signs OTA updates in CI with our own key. The flaw is in signature verification; the app verifies updates natively and never bundles node-forge.

No patched 3.x release exists (the fix is 4.6.6, and zod 4 is a breaking API change). Only reached via expo > @expo/cli, which validates our own app config and CLI arguments at build time. Never bundled into the app, and no attacker-supplied input reaches it.
